comment: Ingestion file for the Seoul hotel-comparison itineraries. Each entry below is one of the 9 Seoul hotels already researched in data/collections/hotels.json. Set "consider": true for the hotels the travel partner is actually deciding between — the build script then spreads the 20 itinerary themes across exactly those hotels. Add a "why" note so the generated plans can speak to her reasons.

hotels.why: Transport-first option — direct Seoul Station / AREX / KTX access is the main advantage.
Budget-quality balance, free breakfast, and a central Myeongdong base.
Mid-range value pick, 1-min walk to Myeongdong Station, airport limousine stops nearby.
Design-lifestyle Lotte hotel, rooftop sky terrace, 2-min walk to Myeongdong Station.
Excellent central Myeongdong location at a budget-friendly tier.
Luxury option in prime Myeongdong location, old-world French glamour.
Freshly renovated, overlooks Ikseon-dong hanok village, walkable to palaces.
Top-tier luxury with palace views, steps from Gwanghwamun & Gyeongbokgung.
Modern luxury on the Han River in Yeouido, beside The Hyundai Seoul mall.
